unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Staying Connected Online
drDigitalIntro:
You practiced messaging and video calls in Unit 5 — now try it on your real device!

1. Open your messaging app (Messages, WhatsApp, or whatever you use).
2. Find a friend or family member in your contacts list and tap their name.
3. Type a short message — even just 'Hi!' — and press Send.
4. If they reply, press and hold their message to send a reaction.
5. Tap the camera or phone icon at the top to start a video call.
6. During the call, find the microphone icon and tap it to mute yourself, then tap again to unmute.
7. When you are done, tap the red button to end the call.

Tip: if you do not know anyone to message, send yourself a note — most apps let you message your own number.
drDigitalSuccess: Staying in touch is just a few taps away. The more you practice, the more natural it feels!
drDigitalHint: Go to your Messages app, find a contact, type a short message, and press Send. You covered all of this in Unit 5.
